title: StateEnvelope
description: V4 envelope wrapping all six domain state files (recidivists.json, abuseipdb-reported.json, modsec-banned.json, cidr-banned.json, cf_waf_state.json, bouncer-abusecheck.json). Written by _atomic_write_json() via mkstemp+fsync+os.replace. See docs/state-format.md for the normative spec. STATE_VERSION=1.

version.description: Format version. Currently always 1 (STATE_VERSION). Bumped only when the envelope structure itself changes. Domain-level format changes use a separate versioning scheme.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime with UTC offset, written by datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() at save time.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON of 'state' (json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)). Verified on load; mismatch triggers reset + .bak rename.

state.description: Domain-specific state dict. Contents are opaque at envelope level — see per-domain schemas below.

$comment: Backward compat: V3 flat files (plain JSON object with no 'version' key) are accepted by _load_json_state() and migrated to V4 envelope on next save. The V3 format is therefore read-only; all writes produce V4.

RecidivistState.description: Contents of recidivists.json state dict. Keys are IP strings or '_cursor' (ISO datetime bookmark).

AbuseReportedState.description: Contents of abuseipdb-reported.json state dict. Keys are IP strings, values are ISO datetime strings (last report time).

ModsecState.description: Contents of modsec-banned.json state dict. Keys are IP strings.

CidrState.description: Contents of cidr-banned.json state dict. Keys are CIDR strings (e.g. '1.2.3.0/24').

CfWafState.description: Contents of cf_waf_state.json state dict. Sparse — may contain only 'last_event_dt' after init.

last_event_dt.description: ISO 8601 datetime of last WAF event processed.

BouncerCheckState.description: Contents of bouncer-abusecheck.json state dict. Keys are IP strings.
